About

Stories first, then systems.

I'm Lakshay, an author who likes building whole worlds out of words. Alongside writing, I study finance and investing, because understanding how money moves is its own kind of storytelling.

In August 2026 I began my B.Tech in Computer Science with a specialisation in AI and Machine Learning at Newton School of Technology. My first mid-semester exams are done, and I'm now building up Python, the command line and GitHub.
